description: The the 2026 World Island Fair Yeosu, an international exhibition centered on islands, kicks off on Saturday in the southern coastal city of Yeosu. The 61-day expo runs through Nov. 4 at the main venue and other locations across Yeosu, including Gaedo and Geumodo islands. A total of 133 performances will be staged alongside a range of exhibitions and hands-on programs. As the country's first international exposition devoted exclusively to islands, the event explores island culture, ecology and l
title: Yeosu's world island expo opens for 61-day run

description: Seoul's taekwondo performance series will return Saturday after a summer break, following a sharp increase in attendance during the first half of the year. Weekend performances will be held at Namsangol Hanok Village in central Seoul through Oct. 18, with shows beginning at 2 p.m. and 4 p.m, according to the Seoul Metropolitan Government. title: Seoul resumes taekwondo performances after attracting 20,000 visitors

description: Seoul will waive parking fees at 61 public parking facilities near major tourist destinations and commercial districts during the Chuseok holiday and implement measures for cemeteries' visitors, according to the Seoul Facilities Corp. on Friday. Those areas include Jongmyo Shrine, Euljiro, Yeouido, Cheonho Station and Sadang Station will be open free of charge around the clock from Sept.24 to 27. The corporation will also implement special measures at 16 city-run cemeteries and cremation facilit
title: Seoul to waive fees at 61 public parking lots during Chuseok

description: Seoul will hold an autumn music festival Saturday at the Changnyeong Wigung Jaesa complex in Dream Forest in Gangbuk-gu, northern Seoul, featuring live performances and craft activities. The event will run from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. around the traditional hanok complex, a nationally registered cultural heritage site. Changnyeong Wigung Jaesa was built for Kim Byung-joo, a son-in-law of King Sunjo, the 23rd monarch of the Joseon era. The site is also associated with Kim Seok-jin, Kim’s grandson, who
title: Historic hanok sets stage for Dream Forest concert in nothern Seoul

description: Hours before the first fireworks were set to light up Seoul's night sky, crowds carrying picnic mats, food and folding chairs began filling Yeouido Hangang Park on Saturday. The annual spectacle transformed not only the riverside but also nearby subway stations, restaurants and convenience stores as the city prepared for one of its biggest nighttime events. title: Seoul braces for crowds as fireworks festival returns

description: A Canadian client came to a Seoul studio this spring and asked for Ilwolobongdo, the sun, moon and five peaks that once hung behind the throne of Joseon kings. It went on his calf as a farewell to the country. He had wanted a minhwa tattoo for years, he said, and could not find anyone making them. Tattooist Choi Hae-sol hears this often. title: Minhwa, inked

description: From cars and designer sofas to luxury watches, some big-ticket purchases are best judged in person rather than through a screen. In South Korea, life-size sex dolls are increasingly joining that list. Showrooms specializing in these products, commonly known as "real dolls," are popping up across the country, bringing what was once largely an online purchase into brick-and-mortar retail. title: What sex doll showrooms say about Korea's once-hidden market

description: For 10 days in June, around 4,000 people gathered in a corner of Yeouido Hangang Park for a pop-up staged at the Kirin Ichiban Premium Beer Bar, a riverside bar run by the Japanese brewer. The draw wasn't the bar's namesake beer, but Hyoketsu, a canned Japanese chuhai, or shochu highball, made of fruit juice and vodka. title: Kirin pours Hyoketsu into Korea’s RTD boom

description: South Korea is likely to experience a warmer winter this year due to a stronger El Nino, which is expected to persist until February, according to the weather agency Friday. Citing the World Meteorological Organization’s latest El Nino-La Nina update, the Korea Meteorological Administration said sea surface temperatures across the central and eastern equatorial Pacific are expected to continue rising through the fall. title: Warmer winter awaits S. Korea as El Nino expected to get stronger

description: The second edition of Seoul Petlympic -- a two-day sports festival for dogs and their owners -- will open on Oct. 24 at Peace Plaza in Mapo-gu, according to the Seoul Metropolitan Government on Friday. Four events will be open to dogs with basic training: staying in place, running to their owners when called, weaving through cones and completing a 15-meter sprint alongside their owners. The competitions will be divided into two weight classes, with up to 100 participants accepted for each event
title: Seoul to host 'Petlympic' for dogs and owners

description: A South Korean man has been sentenced to five years in prison for spying for North Korea, officials said Saturday. The 43-year-old man, whose identity was withheld, was found to have received an order from a North Korean agent via the messaging app Telegram in May-June of 2021 to collect information about anti-Pyongyang defectors from North Korea and their activities. Around that time, the man took about 660 million won (US$479,346) worth of virtual currency from the North Korean agent as funds
title: S. Korean man sentenced to 5 yrs in prison for spying for North Korea
